titles.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together
るいとも〜友達以上恋人未満〜

description:
*“Hi. You’re Doha, right? Yoo Doha.”*

When I was being shunned for liking men, you were the one who came to me with that greeting.

*“I remembered your name because it’s so pretty.”*

It was the first compliment I’d ever heard about the name I’d always despised. Since then, I wished that the words defining you could be things like: your voice, your scent, the neatness of your uniform… The pale fingers that turned book pages, the way your eyes folded into a picture when you smiled, the softness in your tone, or maybe that midsummer day, when you asked nothing and simply held me close.
